que-es.title: What is Ads Holistic?
que-es.content: It’s the panel where you see your TikTok accounts, Hecom balance/debt, top-ups, and chat with the team. Collections and spend data come from the Hecom Club CRM.

menu-cliente.title: Where do I start?
menu-cliente.content: Sign in with your email (OTP). In the left menu you only see your data: Overview, Ad accounts, Payments, and this support chat.

saldo-estimado.title: What is “Estimated balance”?
saldo-estimado.content: It’s not money in TikTok or on your card. It’s the Hecom CRM balance: client collections minus (ad spend + fees). If it’s positive, they paid more than spend/fees. If negative, it’s net debt.

como-recargar.title: How do I top up?
como-recargar.content: As a client: go to Payments → Top up wallet (Stripe / available method). Choose the net amount; the Holistic fee is added to the charge. When payment confirms, you have wallet balance to assign to an ad account.

como-asignar.title: How do I assign balance to an account?
como-asignar.content: In Payments, Assign section: pick an Approved account, amount, and confirm. That moves budget to the TikTok advertiser. Only active/approved accounts appear (not suspended ones).

fee.title: What is the fee?
fee.content: It’s the client’s Holistic % (from Hecom, e.g. 10%). On deposits: you request a net amount; we charge net + fee. In history, the fee also counts in the “charge” alongside ad spend.

ver-cuentas.title: Where do I see my TikTok accounts?
ver-cuentas.content: Ad accounts menu. List of advertisers (name + ID), Active / Suspended status, fee, and timezone. As a client it’s read-only: you don’t create or edit accounts here.

como-escribir.title: How do I use this chat?
como-escribir.content: Write your question here. You can paste screenshots (Ctrl+V) or attach photos/PDFs. A human manager replies (not a bot). Messages update on their own—no need to refresh.

tiempos.title: How long until someone replies?
tiempos.content: The operational goal is to reply in 30 minutes or less during business hours. If it’s urgent, include the details (account, amount, error) so we can move faster.
